html: The Bilinarra, also spelt Bilinara, are an Aboriginal Australian people of the Victoria River district of the Northern Territory. The map shows them from 1600 to 1815. Their neighbours were the Gurindji to the south, the Ngaliwurru and Ngarinyman to the north and west and the Mudburra to the east. Huge cattle stations took over the Victoria River country from the 1880s, and many Bilinarra spent the next century working on them.
